<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 114.068 which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of approximately 113.0608 Da. The formula C₅H₉N₂O has a monoisotopic mass of 113.0715 Da, matching the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance and accounting for the observed M+1 isotopic peak at m/z 115.0715. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₅H₉N₂O.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H9N2O</final_answer>
